generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal
The tender is of two cover system.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT
The rates uploaded in the e procurement portal are exclusive of GST and GST will be paid separately
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd:26.04.2022
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (PCM-1), KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).

Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement in Karnataka Power Corporation Limited may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the Last date of submission of bid
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to be submitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority.

Contract Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to furnish e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG) issued by banks integrated with NeSL /DD/NEFT from a scheduled Bank towards Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG), for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract (i.e. Validity period is the Contract period and including work performance guarantee period) within 20 days from the date of issue of LOI (Letter of Intent). The e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG) shall be furnished in the prescribed format only. The work Performance shall be Nil Months after completing the work. The total contract period is 12 Months. The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract.
Any changes in minimum labour wages during the contractor period will be implemented as per KPCL orders.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one Civil work of value not less than Rs.18.29 Lakhs in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

Financial Turnover: The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs.36.58 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Any reputed individual/Company having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class III & above are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded.
The bidder should upload the scan copy of Income tax PAN.
The bidder should upload the scan copy of Independent PF code
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: scan copy of Independent PF code

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should upload the scan copy of valid GST registration certificate.

Tender capacity (A x N x 2.5 - B) where A- Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N -Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 1 year. B- Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next (12 Months) 1 year period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited and should upload self-declaration stating that the mentioned turnover of our firm is obtained by execution of works only.

The Bidders should upload the following declarations duly signed . I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL/KPWD or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. II. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL/KPWD or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. III. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. IV. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. V. I/we shall pay fair and prevailing wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. VI. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason.
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: The Bidders should upload declarations duly signed.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair/replacement of water distribution pipes of Cooling Towers 2 to 8 for a period of one year at RTPS

itemList.description: Providing and fixing 150mm clear inner dia Asbestos Cement pipes of 3.00m long with Asbestos Cement collar of 15mm wall thickness in Cooling Towers with CM 1:3 proportion and making 65 mm bore at 0.80 m apart and 0.45 m from end in straight line by using drilling machines to make hole including fixing the nozzles to the pipe, removing and disposing the damaged old AC pipes to dump yard etc., complete with all lead and lifts as directed by the Engineer in-charge, (Nozzles will be issued departmently at free of cost)

Providing and fixing 150mm clear inner dia Asbestos Cement pipes of 2.50m long with Asbestos Cement collar of 15mm wall thickness in Cooling Towers with CM 1:3 proportion and making 65 mm bore at 0.80 m apart and 0.45 m from end in straight line by using drilling machines to make hole including fixing the nozzles to the pipe, removing and disposing the damaged old AC pipes to dump yard etc., complete with all lead and lifts as directed by the Engineer in-charge, (Nozzles will be issued departmently at free of cost).

Providing and fixing 200mm clear inner dia Asbestos Cement pipes of 2.50m long with Asbestos Cement collar of 15mm wall thickness in Cooling Towers with CM 1:3 proportion and making 65 mm bore at 0.80 m apart and 0.45 m from end in straight line by using drilling machines to make hole including fixing the nozzles to the pipe, removing and disposing the damaged old AC pipes to dump yard etc., complete with all lead and lifts as directed by the Engineer in-charge, (Nozzles will be issued departmently at free of cost)

Repairs to AC pipe joints of 150mm and 200mm dia distribution system in Cooling Towers by re-doing the damaged joints carefully with C M 1:3 proportion including cost of all men, material requiired for joints such as sand, cement including curing with all leads and lifts etc., complete.

Providing and fixing PVC 200mm dia 6kg/cm2 pressure pipe of approved brand of schedule 80 as per ASTM D1785 of 1.00m length in straight line and fixing the same with necessary collars wherver required etc., including cutting and removing the old damaged PVC pipe, fallen hand rails, fixing the nozzles to the pipes by making holes to PVC pipe by using drilling machine and fixing nozzle with band it band tool and strip and aligning the pipe, disposing the damaged pipe to the scrap yard etc., including the cost of all materials, labour and machineries etc., complete with all lead and lifts. (Band it band tool, strip and nozzle will be issued departmentally)

Providing and fixing PVC 160mm dia 6 kg/cm2 pressure pipe of approved brand of schedule 80 as per ASTM D1785 of 1.00m in straight line and fixing the same with necessary collars, end caps wherver required etc., including cutting and removing the old damaged PVC pipe, fallen hand rails, fixing the nozzles to the pipes by making holes by PVC pipe drilling machine and fixing nozzle with band it band tool and strip and aligning in the proper way, disposing the damaged pipe to the scrap yard etc., including the cost of all materials, labour charges, solvent charges, lead and lifts etc., complete. (Band it band tool, strip and nozzle should be collected from departmental store)

Providing and fixing OPVC pipes of Class 500- PN-16 250mm dia. of 1.00m length in straight line and fixing the same with necessary collars wherver required etc., including cutting and removing the old damaged PVC pipe, fallen hand rails, fixing the nozzles to the pipes by making holes to PVC pipe by using drilling machine and fixing nozzle with band it band tool and strip and aligning the pipe, disposing the damaged pipe to the scrap yard etc., including the cost of all materials, labour and machineries etc., complete with all lead and lifts. (Band it band tool, strip and nozzle will be issued departmentally)

Supplying and fixing ringtite PVC pipes of 200mm dia with 6 kg/cm2 pressure (Class-3) conforming to IS 4985-2000 with latest ammendements and conveying to work site, laying true to line, level and perfect linking at joints, testing and commissioning, including loading and unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointing of PVC pipes with jointing of approved type, with all labour, lead and lifts etc., complete and making 65 mm bore hole at 0.85 m apart and 0.45 m from end in straight line by using drilling machines to make hole including fixing the nozzles to the pipe (Nozzles will be issued departmently free of cost).

Supplying and fixing ringtite PVC pipes of 160mm dia dia with 6 kg/cm2 pressure (Class-3) conforming to IS 4985-2000 with latest ammendements and conveying to work site, laying true to line, level and perfect linking at joints, testing and commissioning, including loading and unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointing of PVC pipes with jointing of approved type, with all labour, lead and lifts etc., complete and making 65 mm bore hole at 0.85 m apart and 0.45 m from end in straight line by using drilling machines to make hole including fixing the nozzles to the pipe (Nozzles will be issued departmently free of cost).
